twoFactor.whatIs2FADesc: Two-factor authentication adds an extra layer of security to your account. When logging in, you'll need to enter both your password and a dynamic code from an authenticator app on your phone.
twoFactor.step1: Download an authenticator app on your phone (Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator recommended)
twoFactor.step2: Open the authenticator app and tap "+" to add an account
twoFactor.step3: Scan the QR code below, or enter the secret key manually
twoFactor.step4: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app to complete setup
twoFactor.scanQRCode: Scan QR code with your authenticator app
twoFactor.manualEntry: Can't scan? Enter secret key manually:
twoFactor.setupWarning: Make sure Glowtype Admin account appears in your authenticator app before proceeding
twoFactor.enterSetupCode: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to complete setup
twoFactor.recoveryCodesWarning: If you lose access to your authenticator, you can use recovery codes to log in. Each code can only be used once.
twoFactor.clickToReveal: Click the eye icon to reveal recovery codes
twoFactor.clipboardWarning: Warning: Clipboard contents may be accessible to other apps. Consider writing them down or taking a screenshot instead.
twoFactor.confirmSaved: I have saved the recovery codes in a safe place and understand they will only be shown once
